blurb: Studio Parallèle offers pole fitness, dance, yoga, and wellness classes in two studios located in Québec and Lévis. They provide 10-week session programs with 90-minute classes, including various levels of pole fitness and other dance styles. They also offer original bachelorette party experiences with pole fitness, chair dance, and twerk classes.
